assignments.date: For bulk items (headphones, mice, cables, SIM cards...) just pick the Category and leave Asset ID blank. For serialized items (laptops, desktops...) pick the Asset ID too — Asset Name fills in automatically. Stock Summary updates itself the moment you log or return an assignment here.

refills.date: How to use: every time new stock arrives, add a new row here — Date, Time, Asset Category, Quantity Added, who added it, and where it came from (PO/vendor). 'Total Stock' on the Stock Summary sheet adds up all rows for each category automatically, so it always reflects every refill you've logged, with a full date-and-time history.
